categories.label: Categories
categories.description: Manage the categories used to classify transactions.
categories.pageDescription: System categories are shared and cannot be edited. Ones you create can be renamed, reordered, deactivated, or deleted once no longer in use.

transactionTypes.label: Transaction types
transactionTypes.description: Map the raw labels from your bank statement to Lumio's transaction types.
transactionTypes.pageDescription: For each raw label used by your bank statement (e.g. "Transfer"), choose here which type Lumio should treat it as. The change also applies to already-imported transactions — except the ones you've already corrected by hand, which stay untouched.

page.infoButton: What does changing the currency mean?

baseCurrency.label: Reference currency
baseCurrency.description: Used to add up net worth, portfolio, and income/expenses when accounts or investments are in different currencies. It doesn't change the original data, only how it is aggregated.

info.title: What changes
info.aggregated: The reference currency decides which currency is used to add up totals that mix accounts/assets in different currencies — net worth, portfolio value, overall income/expenses.
info.originalPreserved: Every transaction, account, and position ALWAYS keeps its own original currency: changing this setting touches no historical data, only how aggregated totals are computed from now on.
info.missingRate: If an exchange rate is missing for a currency in use, that part stays out of the total but is flagged — never a silent exclusion.

rules.label: Rules
rules.description: Automatically classify transactions based on criteria you define.

ai.label: AI
ai.description: Configure an optional AI provider for automatic classification.
ai.pageDescription: AI is optional: transactions are still classified by rules even without an active profile. You can save multiple profiles (even for the same provider) and activate one at a time.

marketData.label: Market data
marketData.description: Configure the quote provider used to refresh investment prices.

integrations.label: Integrations
integrations.description: Export your financial data to Google Sheets.
integrations.pageDescription: Google Sheets is an optional integration: it exports your financial data to a Google spreadsheet, refreshable on demand. Disabling it has no effect on the rest of Lumio.

jobs.label: System jobs
jobs.description: Configure automatic jobs and the ones triggered by your actions.
